method.input_kind: Eight synthetic packed-14 pixel planes with inherited ordinary Z8 metadata, copied and modified for each case.
metadata_edits: MakerNote 0x0023 Picture Control ID and parameter bytes, with version 0311 in one case.
MakerNote 0x005c Flexible parameters, with version 0101 in one case.
MakerNote 0x00b1 High ISO noise reduction values 0, 2, 4 and 6.
MakerNote 0x0062 byte 4 set to 2 in one sharpening case.
method.metadata_consistency_limit: Picture Control textual name and base remain inherited AUTO while ID and relevant parameter bytes change. These are synthetic parser variants, not camera-authored Picture Control records.
method.vendor_execution: Pinned Windows PixelShiftCombine.dll called by probe_pixelshift.exe under Linux Wine; eight inputs produce one output with radial correction disabled.
method.comparison: Parse the output XMP as XML, collect camera-raw-defaults properties from both attributes and child elements, and compare all ten predictions numerically using Decimal.
method.retained_external_evidence: Each report records every modified input hash, source hash, byte patch, prediction, intermediate value, output hash, vendor return code, stdout, stderr and elapsed time.
method.input_integrity: All eight original fixture hashes were checked before each run and after every completed run; originals remained unchanged.
method.runner_changes_after_matrix: Formatting/import ordering, minimum Python version declaration and completion-report safety changed after the 26-case run. Prediction and metadata mutation logic did not change. The final runner was verified with a fresh six-case vendor pilot.

coverage.standard: Manual parameters and default-parameter paths; version 0311 plus the alternate sharpening selector.
coverage.creative: Five representative Creative families; intensity byte values 128, 178, 228 and 255.
coverage.flexible: Neutral, positive and negative values in the fallback contrast/saturation fields.

independent_review.scope: Read-only review of the runner, predictor, probe interface and saved runtime evidence; the reviewer did not independently repeat all vendor executions.
independent_review.finding: An interim report could advertise passed=true before the full matrix and final source-integrity check had completed.
independent_review.resolution: Reports now begin with completed=false and passed=false, record the planned case count, and use atomic replacement. Passed becomes true only after all planned cases succeed and original inputs are rechecked.

interruption_check.method: Substitute one saved vendor output for the first subprocess result, then raise KeyboardInterrupt during the second case. No new vendor execution occurs in this check.
assertions: The report records six planned cases and two attempted cases.
The first case succeeds, but completed and passed remain false.
The final original-input integrity result is absent.

diagnostics: tifffile emits missing data offset and ByteCounts diagnostics while traversing metadata-only MakerNote TIFF structures. Image extraction and comparisons still complete.
Vendor process stderr includes an XDG_RUNTIME_DIR diagnostic under Wine; all recorded successful vendor process exit codes are zero.

reproduction.requirements: Python >=3.12, pinned script dependencies, Linux Wine, pinned fixtures and vendor artifacts. The pinned prm.bin must also exist beside the probe executable.
reproduction.output_policy: The output directory must be new and outside the repository. Proprietary payloads and image data remain external.

limitations: Only the pinned Z8 resource, DLL and inherited source metadata were exercised.
This matrix uses eight-to-one synthesis with radial correction disabled; it does not independently validate 32-frame defaults or 4/16-frame bypass paths.
Creative profiles and parameter ranges are representative rather than exhaustive; inherited ISO, white balance and encrypted ColorBalance metadata remain fixed.
Matching synthetic metadata predictions does not validate authentic pixel-shift captures, visual quality, complete Picture Control fidelity or Lightroom Classic interpretation.
The predictor reads pinned vendor tables at runtime. These results do not establish a vendor-independent implementation.
